notes: Credit transactions of other systems (LINK_FLAG=1): generated payment grid had no BILL_ID2 (the invoice number of stock invoices), rebuilt with explicit columns; legacy rules in APP_RULES_AR (pay method and allocation, discount periods, running balances CRN_BAL_TOTAL, history copies on delete; see processes/ARCRTRN_ST.md)

rules.where: TRNS_ID in (select ID from AR_TRNSTYPE where EFFECT = 1) and TRNS_SERIAL_TOT is null and LINK_FLAG = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or (TRNS_ID in (select TRNS_ID from AR_TRNSTYPE_PASSWORD where FLAG = 1 and PASSWORD_NUMBER = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) and CUSTOMER_ID in (select CUSTOMER_CODE from AR_CUST_PASSWORD where PASSWORD_NUMBER = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) and SALESMAN_ID in (select SALESMAN_CODE from AR_SALESMAN_PASSWORD where PASSWORD_NUMBER = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))))

key_expr.AR_MAINTRNS.CTGRY_CODE: case when v('REQUEST') in ('CREATE', 'SAVE') then app_rules_ar.default_ctgry(:new.trns_id, :new.customer_id) end
key_expr.AR_MAINTRNS.SALESMAN_ID: case when v('REQUEST') in ('CREATE', 'SAVE') then app_rules_ar.default_salesman(:new.trns_id, :new.customer_id, :new.ctgry_code) end

validations.name: رأس الحركة: النوع والعميل والتاريخ والمندوب ومعامل التحويل
validations.plsql: return app_rules_ar.check_header('ARCRTRN_ST', :PAGE_ROWID, to_number(:PAGE_TRNS_ID), to_number(:PAGE_CUSTOMER_ID), to_date(:PAGE_TRNS_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), to_number(:PAGE_CTGRY_CODE), to_number(:PAGE_SALESMAN_ID), to_number(:PAGE_CURRENCY_CODE), to_number(:PAGE_CURRENCY_RATE));

validations.name: الحركة المرحلة أو المسددة لا تعدل
حفظ تفاصيل السداد قبل التعديل (لإرجاع المتبقي بالفواتير عند حذف سطر)

after_save.name: تفاصيل السداد والمتبقي والإجماليات ورصيد العميل

AR_MAINTRNS.PAY_METHOD.label_a: طريقة الدفع (1 تنازلي على الفواتير / 2 شاشة مساعدة للفواتير / 4 مبلغ دائن لعميل)
AR_MAINTRNS.PAY_METHOD.label_e: Pay method (1 descending on invoices / 2 helping invoice screen / 4 debit sum for client)

AR_MAINTRNS.CTGRY_CODE.lov: select category_type_code || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(category_type_desce, category_type_desca) else category_type_desca end d, category_type_code r from st_category_type order by category_type_code

AR_MAINTRNS.SALESMAN_ID.lov: select code || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(name_e, name_a) else name_a end d, code r from salesman where code in (select salesman_code from ar_cust_salesman where customer_code = :PAGE_CUSTOMER_ID and ctgry_code = :PAGE_CTGRY_CODE) and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or code in (select salesman_code from ar_salesman_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by code

AR_MAINTRNS.POST_SYSTEM.lov: select case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(system_desc_e, system_desc_a) else system_desc_a end d, system_number r from sys_systems where system_number not in (0, 99) order by system_number

AR_MAINTRNS.TRNS_ACCOUNT.lov: select account_number || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(account_name_e, account_name) else account_name end d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or account_number in (select p2.account_number from ac_password_master p2 where p2.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p2.company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE))) order by account_number

AR_MAINTRNS.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT.lov: select account_number || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(account_name_e, account_name) else account_name end d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or account_number in (select p2.account_number from ac_password_master p2 where p2.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p2.company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE))) order by account_number

AR_MAINTRNS.DISC_ACCOUNT.lov: select account_number || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(account_name_e, account_name) else account_name end d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or account_number in (select p2.account_number from ac_password_master p2 where p2.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p2.company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE))) order by account_number

AR_MAINTRNS.COST_CODE1.lov: select cost_code || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(cost_desc_e, cost_desc) else cost_desc end d, cost_code r from ac_cost_centers where cost_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or cost_code in (select p2.cost_code from ac_password_cost1 p2 where p2.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p2.company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE))) order by cost_code

AR_MAINTRNS.TRNS_ID.lov: select id || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(description_e, description_a) else description_a end d, id r from ar_trnstype where effect = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or id in (select trns_id from ar_trnstype_password where flag = 1 and password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by id

AR_MAINTRNS.MAINAREA_NAME.sql: (select max(a.name_a) from ar_mainarea a where a.id = t.mainarea_id)

AR_MAINTRNS.SUBAREA_NAME.sql: (select max(s.name_a) from ar_subarea s where s.main_id = t.mainarea_id and s.id = t.subarea_id)

AR_SUBTRNS.INV_TRNS_DATE.sql: (select max(s.inv_date) from ar_subtrns s where s.trns_id = t.inv_trns_id and s.trns_serial = t.inv_trns_serial and s.mainarea_id = t.inv_mainarea_id and s.subarea_id = t.inv_subarea_id and s.bill_seq = t.inv_bill_seq)

AR_SUBTRNS.INV_TOTAL_VALUE.sql: (select max(s.total_value) from ar_subtrns s where s.trns_id = t.inv_trns_id and s.trns_serial = t.inv_trns_serial and s.mainarea_id = t.inv_mainarea_id and s.subarea_id = t.inv_subarea_id and s.bill_seq = t.inv_bill_seq)

AR_SUBTRNS.INV_RESIDUAL_VALUE.sql: (select max(s.residual_value) from ar_subtrns s where s.trns_id = t.inv_trns_id and s.trns_serial = t.inv_trns_serial and s.mainarea_id = t.inv_mainarea_id and s.subarea_id = t.inv_subarea_id and s.bill_seq = t.inv_bill_seq)

AR_SUBTRNS.TOTAL_VALUE_RIYALH.sql: nvl((select max(m.currency_rate) from ar_maintrns m where m.trns_id = t.trns_id and m.mainarea_id = t.mainarea_id and m.subarea_id = t.subarea_id and m.trns_serial = t.trns_serial), 0) * nvl(t.total_value, 0)

params.name: INVOICE
params.lov_sql: select s.bill_id2 || '/' || s.bill_id1 || ' - ' || to_char(s.inv_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') || ' (' || to_char(s.residual_value, 'FM999G999G990D00') || ')' d, s.trns_id || ':' || s.mainarea_id || ':' || s.subarea_id || ':' || s.trns_serial || ':' || s.bill_seq r from ar_subtrns s join ar_maintrns m on m.trns_id = s.trns_id and m.mainarea_id = s.mainarea_id and m.subarea_id = s.subarea_id and m.trns_serial = s.trns_serial where m.trns_id in (select id from ar_trnstype where effect = 0) and nvl(s.residual_value, 0) != 0 and m.customer_id = to_number(:PAGE_CUSTOMER_ID) and m.ctgry_code = to_number(:PAGE_CTGRY_CODE) and app_act_ar.in_payment(:PAGE_ROWID, s.bill_id1, s.bill_id2) = 0 order by m.trns_date, s.bill_id1, s.bill_id2

params.name: AMOUNT
params.label_a: المسدد شامل الخصم (فارغ = الأقل من المتبقي بالسند والفاتورة)
params.label_e: Amount incl. discount (empty = the smaller open value)
